axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: All required target/edit/reconnect cases, identity versus appearance, original context, unresolved threads, retention and export are addressed; no forbidden automatic fallback, silent resurrection or invisible-thread loss is proposed.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.basis: Pinned Rust API/defaults, shared-type context, bindings, code/test/fix history and applicability were checked. T-N1/T-N2 are nonmaterial optional-mechanism/history qualifications.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.basis: Tree visibility/moves, sequence anchoring/defaults, nested deletion/GC regression and map conflicts are useful discoveries. Sequencing and event/snapshot alternatives are materially different; no engine is selected.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: All sixteen plan clauses and CR-01 through CR-05 are examined. Critic severity is sometimes overstated (T-N3); the final choices are disclosed design policies, not uniquely mandated library truths.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.basis: Original identity/context, stale-edit recovery, supported mechanisms and alternatives, privacy/export policy and validation status survive. Incarnation-on-restore replaces a predecessor schema choice while retaining explicit restoration and historical linkage.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.basis: The proposed matrix separates convergence, semantic attachment, stale-peer recovery, export and privacy oracles. No executed merge/test/deployment claim is made. Optional sequence tests have the T-N1 qualification.

coverage_definition: COMPLETE means the entire declared planning brief, exact plan, all available stage science and consequential obligations/claims were assessed at finite depth. It is not universal correctness or deployed behavior. No decisive early-stop shortcut was used.
